operation.description:
Lists self-hosted runners that are in a specific organization group.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: List self-hosted runners in a group for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/runner-group-id.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner group.
#/components/parameters/runner-group-id.name: runner_group_id

os.description: The Operating System of the runner.

runner_group_id.description: The ID of the runner group.

version.description: The version of the GitHub Actions Runner software. This is only set if the runner has connected to the service at least once.

#/components/schemas/runner-label.description: A label for a self hosted runner

type.description: The type of label. Read-only labels are applied automatically when the runner is configured.

#/components/schemas/runner-label.title: Self hosted runner label
